  severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A run whose display_title exactly matches the escalated issue title is accepted as proof of association without an issue-specific link.
  WHY: Two issues in the same repository with identical titles would cause a failed run from one issue to pass provenance verification for the other, allowing the intake to fetch its jobs and logs. The title-match criterion is a fallback when no trusted comment links the run and (for PRs) no PR association exists; its logs can enter the diagnosis prompt.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: File: scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py; Location: _verify_label_run_refs, title-match fallback (lines 1820-1821). Suggested minimal fix: Restrict the title-match to runs whose created_at is on or after the issue's creation timestamp, available in the payload as issue_created_at; this narrows the window without changing the criterion's shape.
